key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0A50
name: set_object_state_and_flags
description: Adds four to a 16-bit counter in the object at A0 and stores seven in a state byte of that object. It sets one bit and clears another in the object's flag byte, calls two routines through the A5 jump table, and sets a bit in a global byte.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0A8E
name: check_object_then_dispatch
description: Returns early unless a 16-bit field of the object at A0 is below 79 and A1 differs from A0. When both hold it calls another routine and, if the value in D7 is below 18, calls a routine through the A5 jump table.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0ABC
name: dispatch_object_update_by_type
description: Returns early when a type byte is zero or the object's values are out of range. Otherwise it sets a flag bit, looks up two scale values in a table indexed by the object's type code, and multiplies them with the object's dimension fields. It then calls the update routine that matches the type code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0C12
name: accumulate_indexed_table_step
description: Reads a 4-bit index from a global byte and looks up a word in a fixed table. For low indexes it calls a routine and adds eight times the word to a counter in the object, setting a companion word to a constant. For higher indexes it adds a shifted, scaled product to the counter, then calls a routine and returns its result shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0C6E
name: add_shifted_product_saturated
description: Multiplies a value in D0 by the high word of D4, clamps the product to 16 bits, shifts it right by a count read from a table, and adds it to the counter in the object with saturation at 65535. It calls a routine before and returns the result of a second routine shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0CB8
name: update_object_type_one
description: Sets a flag bit, computes a scaled offset from the first pair of table fields and clears a status word. It then runs the common update tail, which may copy six long words into a record when a global word is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0CDA
name: update_object_alternate_pair
description: Sets a flag bit and selects one of two table word pairs according to the sign of a global word. It computes a scaled offset from the chosen pair, clears a status word and runs the common update tail.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0CF8
name: update_object_default_pair
description: Computes a scaled offset from the second table word pair, clears a status word and runs the common update tail without setting a flag bit.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0D02
name: copy_record_adjust_counter
description: Does nothing when a global word is zero. Otherwise, after a conditional call, it copies six register values into a record at offset 44 of the object, sets two byte fields and a word to fixed markers, and calls two routines. Bit one of the flags argument adds two to a counter word and bit two subtracts one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0D6C
name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the 8-byte value passed as the first stack argument with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0D76
name: clear_pending_init_object
description: Returns its input unchanged when the object's pending byte is zero. Otherwise it clears that byte, adjusts a counter in the object, sets fixed display and state fields and copies a null-terminated label from a global string into the object's name field. It calls routines and returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0DBC
name: init_mine_label_fields
description: Increments a counter in the object at A0, sets fixed display fields in the object at A1 and copies the text label Mine into its name field. It calls routines, clears a word field and returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0DF2
name: init_missile_label_fields
description: Sets a word field to a fixed value, copies the text label Missile into the object's name field and stores a passed byte and a size word of eight. It calls routines, clears a word field and returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0E36
name: finalize_object_state_update
description: Calls a routine, then if one object's type byte is 11 and its state byte is below 40 it sets that state to 40 and copies a byte from the other object. It copies another byte between the two objects, clears a word field, calls two routines and returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0ED0
name: invoke_routine_return_minus_one
description: Calls a routine and returns minus one. The code shows no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0EF0
name: add_signed_fixed_values
description: Adds three 32-bit values from registers D0, D1 and D2 into the longword fields of the object at A1 starting at offset 44. For each one it also adds the sign extension of the value and the carry from the addition into the following longword.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:000E
name: update_slot_by_code
description: Compares a code value with four global slot registers. When it matches one, it stores a passed word into a per-code global and sets a status word, with special values for codes 14 to 17. Otherwise it stores the word for that code and claims a free slot, clearing a 32-word block.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0036
name: enter_slot_update_variant_one
description: Single-instruction entry into the shared slot-update logic, which stores a passed word into a per-code global and may clear a 32-word block when a slot is claimed.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0052
name: enter_slot_update_variant_two
description: Single-instruction entry into the shared slot-update logic, which stores a passed word into a per-code global and may clear a 32-word block when a slot is claimed.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0056
name: enter_slot_update_variant_three
description: Single-instruction entry into the shared slot-update logic, which stores a passed word into a per-code global and may clear a 32-word block when a slot is claimed.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:005A
name: enter_slot_update_variant_four
description: Single-instruction entry into the shared slot-update logic, which stores a passed word into a per-code global and may clear a 32-word block when a slot is claimed.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:005E
name: run_slot_update_with_reset
description: Resets the slot status and state words, then runs the shared slot-update logic, which stores a passed word into a per-code global and may clear a 32-word block when a slot is claimed.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:00DA
name: check_threshold_then_store
description: Compares a passed word with a threshold selected by a code value. Below the threshold it clears the status words and returns. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global and runs the slot-update path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0138
name: check_threshold_then_store_b
description: Compares a passed word with a threshold for a narrower set of codes and returns early when it is below. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global or sets special words for codes 14 to 17.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0150
name: check_threshold_then_store_c
description: Checks a passed word against a threshold selected for codes 7 to 11 and returns early when it is below. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global or sets special words for codes 14 to 17.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0168
name: check_threshold_then_store_d
description: Compares a passed word with a threshold for codes 8 to 11 and returns early when it is below. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global or sets special words for codes 14 to 17.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0180
name: check_threshold_then_store_e
description: Compares a passed word with a threshold for codes 9 to 11 and returns early when it is below. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global or sets special words for codes 14 to 17.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0198
name: check_threshold_then_store_f
description: Compares a passed word with a threshold for codes 10 and 11 and returns early when it is below. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global or sets special words for codes 14 to 17.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:01B0
name: check_threshold_then_store_g
description: Compares a passed word with a threshold for code 11 and returns early when it is below. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global or sets special words for codes 14 to 17.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:01C8
name: check_default_threshold_then_store
description: Compares a passed word with the default threshold, used for codes outside the specific lists, and returns early when it is below. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global or sets special words for codes 14 to 17.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:01E0
name: check_threshold_then_store_h
description: Compares a passed word with the general threshold and returns early when it is below. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global or sets special words for codes 14 to 17, then runs the slot-claim path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:01EE
name: check_threshold_then_store_i
description: Compares a passed word with a second threshold entry and returns early when it is below. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global or sets special words for codes 14 to 17, then runs the slot-claim path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:01FC
name: check_threshold_then_claim_slot
description: Compares a passed word with a threshold selected by code and returns early when it is below. Otherwise it stores the word into a per-code global or sets special words for codes 14 to 17, then runs the slot-claim path, which may clear a 32-word block and record the code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0294
name: store_code_eleven_then_claim
description: Stores the passed word into the per-code global for code 11 and runs the slot-claim path, which may clear a 32-word block and record the code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:029E
name: store_code_ten_then_claim
description: Stores the passed word into the per-code global for code 10 and runs the slot-claim path, which may clear a 32-word block and record the code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:02A8
name: store_code_nine_then_claim
description: Stores the passed word into the per-code global for code 9 and runs the slot-claim path, which may clear a 32-word block and record the code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:02B2
name: store_code_eight_then_claim
description: Stores the passed word into the per-code global for code 8 and runs the slot-claim path, which may clear a 32-word block and record the code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:02BC
name: store_code_seven_then_claim
description: Stores the passed word into the per-code global for code 7 and runs the slot-claim path, which may clear a 32-word block and record the code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:02C6
name: store_code_six_then_claim
description: Stores the passed word into the per-code global for code 6 and runs the slot-claim path, which may clear a 32-word block and record the code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:02D0
name: store_code_five_then_claim
description: Stores the passed word into the per-code global for code 5 and runs the slot-claim path, which may clear a 32-word block and record the code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:02DC
name: store_code_35_then_claim
description: Stores the passed word into the per-code global for code 35 and runs the slot-claim path, which may clear a 32-word block and record the code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:02E6
name: store_code_36_then_claim
description: Stores the passed word into the per-code global for code 36 and runs the slot-claim path, which may clear a 32-word block and record the code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:02F0
name: apply_special_codes_range
description: Sets a fixed special word for codes 14 to 17 and returns early when the code matches an active slot. Otherwise it sets the special word and continues with the slot-claim path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0330
name: apply_special_codes_from_14
description: Entry for codes 14 to 17 that sets the matching special word and returns early, otherwise falling through to the slot-claim path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0346
name: apply_special_codes_from_15
description: Entry for codes 15 to 17 that sets the matching special word and returns early, otherwise falling through to the slot-claim path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:035C
name: apply_special_codes_from_16
description: Entry for codes 16 and 17 that sets the matching special word and returns early, otherwise falling through to the slot-claim path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0372
name: apply_special_code_17
description: Entry for code 17 that sets its special word and returns early, otherwise falling through to the slot-claim path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0388
name: apply_special_codes_no_return
description: Sets the special word for codes 14 to 17 without returning early, then runs the slot-claim path unless the code is outside that range.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:039E
name: apply_special_word_b
description: Sets the special word for codes 15 to 17 without returning early, then runs the slot-claim path unless the code is outside that range.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:03B4
name: apply_special_word_c
description: Sets the special word for codes 16 and 17 without returning early, then runs the slot-claim path unless the code is outside that range.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:03CA
name: set_special_word_17
description: Sets the special word for code 17 and then runs the slot-claim path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:040E
name: claim_audio_channel_three
description: Tries to claim audio channel three for the passed code. When its slot is free it clears a 32-word block, records the code in the slot and sets a status byte; otherwise it moves on to the next slot check. It references the channel-three location register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0466
name: claim_audio_channel_two
description: Tries to claim audio channel two for the passed code. When its slot is free it clears a 32-word block, records the code in the slot and sets a status byte; otherwise it moves on to the next slot check. It references the channel-two location register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:04BE
name: claim_audio_channel_one
description: Tries to claim audio channel one for the passed code. When its slot is free it clears a 32-word block, records the code in the slot and sets a status byte; otherwise it moves on to the next slot check. It references the channel-one location register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0516
name: claim_audio_channel_zero
description: Tries to claim audio channel zero for the passed code. When its slot is free it clears a 32-word block, records the code in the slot and sets a status byte; otherwise it moves on to the next slot check. It references the channel-zero location register and is called by many routines.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0576
name: claim_channel_fallback
description: Checks a status flag and a global slot word, then clears a 32-word block and records the code in a slot when that slot is free. It falls through to an alternative check when the slot is busy.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:058C
name: claim_channel_fallback_b
description: Claims a slot for the passed code using the first free-slot check, clearing a 32-word block and setting a status byte. A second check handles the case where the first slot is busy.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:059A
name: claim_slot_status_three
description: Records the passed code in the third status slot and clears its 32-word block when that slot is free, then sets the status byte to three. It falls back to the next check when the slot is busy.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:05A8
name: claim_slot_two_or_one
description: Clears a 32-word block and records the passed code in either the second or the first status slot, depending on whether the second slot is free, and sets the matching status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:05B6
name: claim_slot_status_one
description: Clears a 32-word block, records the passed code in the first status slot and sets the status byte to one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:05C4
name: route_audio_channels
description: Compares a global code word with the four audio channel slot words and calls a handler for the matching channel. It then resets the code word to zero. The routine references all four channel location registers.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:064E
name: reset_audio_channel_state
description: Sets a status word, then for each of the four audio channel slots calls a routine and clears a 32-word block. It clears the status word at the end.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:06E6
name: set_flag_and_store_word
description: Sets one global word to one, stores the low word of D0 into a second global word and sets a third global word to 64.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:06FE
name: set_flag_two_store_word
description: Sets one global word to two, stores the low word of D0 into a second global word and clears a third global word.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0716
name: start_sound_effect
description: Returns early when the level argument is zero or above 64. If the sound identifier already plays on one of the channels it calls two routines and clears the status flag. Otherwise it selects a channel and starts the sound.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:079A
name: select_audio_channel
description: Chooses an audio channel index. It takes the first of channels one to four whose slot is free, and when all are busy it picks the channel with the lowest comparison value.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:07AC
name: select_audio_channel_b
description: Makes the same channel choice as its neighbour after the first free-slot test, and falls through to the lowest-value comparison when all four channels are busy.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:07D2
name: select_audio_channel_from_two
description: Chooses an audio channel from two to four: channel two if its slot is free, then three, and otherwise the channel with the lowest comparison value.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:07F2
name: select_audio_channel_from_three
description: Chooses an audio channel from three or four: channel three if its slot is free, and otherwise the channel with the lowest comparison value.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0812
name: select_lowest_priority_channel
description: Finds the channel with the lowest comparison value among the four. It clears the status flag and returns when the level argument is below that value; otherwise it sets the chosen channel index and continues.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0832
name: select_channel_within_level
description: Finds the lowest comparison value across the four channels and records its index. When that value does not exceed the level argument it sets the chosen channel index and continues; otherwise it returns with the status flag cleared.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:089A
name: start_channel_record_status
description: Stores sound parameters into the channel record at A2, including fields at offsets 8, 12, 14 and 20, sets the status flag and calls routines. It clears the flag afterwards and records the result status in the channel record.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:08DE
name: record_channel_status_flags
description: Stores the status word into the record at A1 and sets one channel-busy flag pair chosen by the status value: four, three, two or any other value. It then clears the status flag.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0906
name: clear_channel_busy_by_code
description: Clears one channel-busy global chosen by the low word of D0: three, two, or any other value, and sets a companion flag. It then clears the status flag.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0920
name: clear_channel_busy_short
description: Clears one channel-busy global when the low word of D0 is two, otherwise a second one, sets a companion flag and clears the status flag.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:093A
name: reset_channel_flag_pair
description: Sets one global word to zero and a second global word to one, then clears the status flag.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0954
name: call_two_routines_clear_flag
description: Calls two routines and clears a status flag. The code shows no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0964
name: release_channel_store_request
description: Marks the record at A1 as active and clears the busy flag of the channel named by its stored status: four, three, two or any other value. It then stores the passed registers and address into the record's fields and clears its last field.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:097E
name: release_channel_store_request_b
description: Clears the busy flag for channel three or two, or the first channel otherwise, then stores the passed registers and address into the record and clears its last field.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0990
name: release_channel_store_request_c
description: Clears the busy flag for channel two or the first channel, then stores the passed registers and address into the record and clears its last field.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:09A4
name: store_regs_to_block_b
description: Clears one channel busy flag, then stores the passed registers and address into the record and clears its last field.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:09AA
name: store_regs_to_block
description: Sets the record's first word to one, stores data registers and an address register into its fields and sets its last word to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:09C8
name: set_audio_channel_registers_b
description: Clears the request's active word and, unless the channel for its status is busy, writes the record's period and volume words to that channel's hardware registers. Otherwise it clears the active word and a field and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:09CE
name: set_audio_channel_registers
description: Checks the busy flag for the channel named by the request's status. If it is free, writes the request's volume and period values to that channel's audio hardware registers; if it is busy, clears the request's active word and a field.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0ABE
name: load_table_entry_into_globals
description: Stores a passed word into a global, clears a block of 136 words, and when the selector word is nonzero copies four long words from the table entry for that selector into globals.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0AC2
name: load_table_entry_variant_b
description: Single-instruction entry into the shared table-loading routine, which stores a word, clears a 136-word block and copies a table entry into globals when the selector is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0AC6
name: load_table_entry_variant_c
description: Single-instruction entry into the shared table-loading routine, which stores a word, clears a 136-word block and copies a table entry into globals when the selector is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0ACA
name: load_table_entry_variant_d
description: Entry into the shared table-loading routine with its own short prologue, which stores a word, clears a 136-word block and copies a table entry into globals when the selector is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0AE2
name: load_table_entry_variant_e
description: Single-instruction entry into the shared table-loading routine, which stores a word, clears a 136-word block and copies a table entry into globals when the selector is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0AE6
name: load_table_entry_variant_f
description: Single-instruction entry into the shared table-loading routine, which stores a word, clears a 136-word block and copies a table entry into globals when the selector is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0AEA
name: load_table_entry_variant_g
description: Single-instruction entry into the shared table-loading routine, which stores a word, clears a 136-word block and copies a table entry into globals when the selector is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0AFA
name: load_table_entry_with_restore
description: Clears a block of 136 word globals and, when the selector word is nonzero, copies four pointer values from the table entry for that selector into globals. Further steps copy more values into the same globals.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0C2C
name: advance_timed_sequence
description: Returns at once when a stop flag is set. Otherwise, for a sequence mode of one, it advances a step counter and, when the counter reaches its limit, decrements the remaining count and resets the counter. It then runs the per-step routines.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0E1C
name: stop_audio_channel_by_code
description: Clears the busy flag for the channel matching the code argument, which is four, three, two or one, and then calls routines that finish stopping that channel. The routines reference the audio channel location registers.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0F10
name: set_flag_one_and_call
description: Sets one global flag to one and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0F34
name: reset_channel_variables_from_table
description: Calls a routine, then for each channel group whose flag is one clears its two variables. It finally loads a value from a table into a global word.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0FB0
name: clear_flag_and_call
description: Sets one global flag to zero and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:0FD4
name: set_flag_process_channel
description: Sets one global word to one and then calls a sequence of routines that process audio channel state, referencing the channel-zero location register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:106C
name: set_flag_call_b
description: Sets one global word to one and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1090
name: clear_channel_two_index
description: Calls a routine, then loads a long from a table at the index held in a global word, and clears that word and a companion word.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:10BC
name: clear_flag_and_call_b
description: Sets a global word to zero and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:10E0
name: set_flag_process_channel_b
description: Sets one global word to one and calls a sequence of routines that process the audio channel, referencing the channel-one location register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1178
name: set_flag_call_c
description: Sets one global word to one and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:119C
name: clear_channel_three_index
description: Calls a routine, then loads a long from a table at the index held in the channel-three global, and clears that index and a companion word.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:11C8
name: clear_flag_and_call_c
description: Sets a global word to zero and calls a routine that updates the channel-two control fields, referencing the channel-two location register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:11EC
name: set_flag_call_d
description: Sets one global word to one and calls another routine. The entry also touches the channel-two location register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1286
name: set_flag_call_e
description: Sets one global word to one and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:12AA
name: clear_channel_four_index
description: Calls a routine, then loads a long from a table at the index held in the channel-four global, and clears that index and a companion word.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:12D6
name: clear_flag_and_call_d
description: Sets one global word to zero and calls a routine that updates the channel-three control fields, referencing the channel-three location register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:12FA
name: set_flag_call_f
description: Sets one global word to one and calls a routine that updates the channel-three control fields, referencing the channel-three location register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:131E
name: process_dma_control_block
description: Advances a DMA control block for an audio channel. When the block's counter is zero it reads the next command word from the block pointer, dispatches on it through a jump table and updates the channel's fields. Writes to the DMA control register enable channels.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:149E
name: load_dma_command_word
description: Reads a command word from the block at A1 and returns at once when it is zero. Otherwise it stores the word in the channel fields, decrements a counter and advances the block pointer. Writes to the DMA control register enable channels.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:14EE
name: start_dma_sequence
description: Stores the first word of the block at A1 as the channel counter, advances the block pointer past it and points the sample pointer at the shared data. When a flag is set it reads the first sample word and writes to the DMA control register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1574
name: dispatch_dma_list_entry
description: Fetches the next entry of a DMA list in the block at A1, either decrementing a counter or following a pointer, and dispatches on it through a jump table. A zero entry returns at once; other entries are stored in the channel fields.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1586
name: dispatch_dma_list_entry_b
description: Decrements the list counter in the block at A1, reads the entry it points to and dispatches on it through a jump table. A zero entry returns at once; other entries are stored in the channel fields.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1594
name: clear_status_bit_dispatch_entry
description: Clears bit one of a global status byte, then dispatches the next DMA list entry through a jump table as the other entry routines do. The status byte is the one shared with the CIA port register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:15A0
name: set_status_bit_dispatch_entry
description: Sets bit one of a global status byte, then dispatches the next DMA list entry through a jump table as the other entry routines do. The status byte is the one shared with the CIA port register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:15AC
name: copy_channel_sample_fields
description: Copies a control word from the block pointed to by A1 into the channel record. When that word is zero it copies a long and a word into the channel's sample fields; otherwise it copies them into alternate fields at other offsets.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:15DC
name: advance_channel_list_pointer
description: Advances the channel's list pointer by four bytes, wrapping to a saved base pointer when the current entry is zero, and fetches the entry it points to for further processing.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:15F6
name: store_sample_pointer_dispatch
description: Stores the long word at the list pointer into the channel's field at offset 62, sets its list pointer and dispatches the word that follows through a jump table. A zero entry returns at once.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1604
name: store_range_fields_dispatch
description: Stores two long words from the block at A1 into the channel's fields at offsets 8 and 12, then dispatches the word that follows through a jump table. A zero entry returns at once.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1610
name: store_triple_fields_dispatch
description: Sets a word field to one, stores three long words from the block into fields at offsets 50, 54 and 58, then dispatches the word that follows through a jump table.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1626
name: clear_field_eight_dispatch
description: Clears the channel word at offset 8 and dispatches the next list entry through a jump table, as the other entry routines do.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:162E
name: clear_field_sixteen_dispatch
description: Clears the channel word at offset 16 and dispatches the next list entry through a jump table, as the other entry routines do.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1636
name: release_channel_for_code
description: Reads the code word in the channel record. Codes 6, 5 and 7 each store fixed values into three global words and clear the busy word of the matching channel; other codes are handled by the following branch.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1658
name: enable_audio_channel_zero
description: Sets three global control words and clears the busy word of channel zero. The routine also touches the channel-zero period and volume registers and the DMA control register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:167C
name: enable_audio_channel_one
description: Sets a global control word to the bit mask for channel one, then to one and zero, and clears the busy word of that channel. The routine touches the channel-one period and volume registers and the DMA control register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:16A0
name: enable_audio_channel_two
description: Sets a global control word to the bit mask for channel two, then to one and zero, and clears the busy word of that channel. The routine touches the channel-two period and volume registers and the DMA control register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:16C4
name: enable_audio_channel_three
description: Sets a global control word to the bit mask for channel three, then to one and zero, and clears the busy word of that channel. The routine touches the channel-three period and volume registers and the DMA control register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:16E8
name: disable_audio_channel_zero
description: Sets a global control word to one and then to zero. The routine touches the channel-zero period and volume registers and the DMA control register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1702
name: disable_audio_channel_one
description: Sets a global control word to the bit mask for channel one and then to zero. The routine touches the channel-one period and volume registers and the DMA control register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:171C
name: disable_audio_channel_two
description: Sets a global control word to the bit mask for channel two and then to zero. The routine touches the channel-two period and volume registers and the DMA control register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1736
name: disable_audio_channel_three
description: Sets a global control word to the bit mask for channel three and then to zero. The routine touches the channel-three period and volume registers and the DMA control register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1750
name: set_field_dispatch_entry
description: Sets a word field to one and dispatches the next list entry through a jump table, as the other entry routines do. A zero entry returns at once.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:1762
name: dispatch_next_list_pointer
description: Advances the list pointer by four bytes, reads the word it points to and dispatches it through a jump table. A zero entry returns at once.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:26314
name: clear_flag_call_result
description: Clears a byte in the global block, calls another routine, sets a global byte to one and returns the result of that call.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:2632E
name: call_routine_then_set_flag
description: Calls another routine, sets a global state byte to one and returns the values held in D0 and D1.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:26346
name: update_state_when_negative
description: When the value in D0 is negative or a global byte is set, it clears bit six of a state byte and calls two routines if that bit was set. It then clears a global flag and continues with a table-driven update of stored values.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:263CE
name: set_flag_if_byte_zero
description: Stores minus one in a global byte when another global byte is zero, otherwise stores zero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:263D2
name: set_flag_from_zero_condition
description: Stores minus one in a global byte when the processor's zero condition is set, otherwise stores zero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:263D8
name: reset_state_index_nine
description: Sets a status word to minus one, clears a global byte and a global word, stores nine in the index word and calls another routine. It returns the values held in D0 and D1.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:26402
name: store_code_if_enabled
description: When a global byte is set it stores the passed value as the current code and clears the status flag, then calls another routine. Code 20 is skipped when another flag is clear.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:26432
name: store_value_and_call
description: Stores the value in D0 into a global word and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:26448
name: clamp_level_and_store_code
description: When a global byte is set, clamps the level word in D1 to 63 and, when it is nonzero, stores the passed value as the current code, clears the status flag and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:3:26476
name: call_routine_if_negative_status
description: Calls another routine when a global byte is set and a status word is negative; otherwise it returns.
